title: 费德提克·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 稻草与木材构成不对称身躯，红布碎片衬着笼架般胸腔结构。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Fiddlesticks is an asymmetrical scarecrow-like figure assembled from straw, dark timber, red cloth scraps, and a cage-like torso frame. Preserve the long articulated limbs, patched tilted head, and unmistakable nonhuman construction. Use a composed simplified face with no frightening open mouth or decaying anatomy. Its curved scythe is planted safely beside the body with the blade down, never raised.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: straw gold, weathered timber, faded crimson, blue sky; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
